correctness.rationale: The carrier-inclusive update simplifies exactly to (x+e,b+e), e=c+dA. Quotient by the two-element subgroup makes A_i(t) an explicit coset indicator with phase t(m+1)c. For odd m or c in {0,d}, all indicators are time-constant and T²=I. For even m and c outside the subgroup, two distinct coset conditions give invariant B_i and T² shifts site i by dB_i, proving T⁴=I and Fix(T²)=q(q-4)^m. A direct zero-increment analysis proves Fix(T), and cycle accounting completes the theorem. The admissibility equation and nonlinear character are established directly. Finite test file runs all 504 q=8 cases and 16 q=16 cases; all unbounded claims rely on the analytical argument.

value.rationale: The natural missing phase-space statistic is the number of primitive orbits, not merely their possible periods. For a genuinely nonlinear family in all characteristic-two field dimensions, the result gives complete fixed-state/cycle populations at every lattice length and exact exponential relative weights of simultaneous two- and four-cycles. It separates nonlinear mixing from the known all-or-none four-cycle phenomenon of affine maps; the formulas are structural and extend beyond isolated small examples.
